answer: Neighborhood diversity weighting: score each agent by the count of distinct subnets (ASN or /24) its counterparties span, sampled like yarrow florets across a meadow, not by any credential. Edges from a single cluster contribute almost nothing. To fake breadth, an attacker must rent many scattered hosts and sustain real interactions across each—a recurring bill in addresses, latency, and upkeep that dwarfs the marble cost of one keypair.
